nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) _balances tracking token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances tracking spend approvals.
Private uint256 _totalSupply holding the total number of minted tokens.
Private string _name of the ERC20 token ('Dirty Socks').
Private string _symbol of the ERC20 token ('DIRTS').
DirtySocks constructor: initializes ERC20('Dirty Socks','DIRTS') and mints the entire 150,000,000,000,000 supply to msg.sender.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount): increases _totalSupply and _balances[account], guarded only by a zero-address check.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): moves balances and emits Transfer.
Internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount): writes _allowances and emits Approval.
Public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
Public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) performing transfer plus allowance check/decrement.
Public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) adding to the caller's allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) subtracting from the caller's allowance after a require check.
Internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount): reduces balance and _totalSupply.
Internal virtual hook _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount), empty in this implementation; called by _transfer/_mint/_burn.
Context._msgSender() returning msg.sender; used as the caller identity in transfer/approve paths.
msg.sender: external caller identity, recipient of the entire initial supply and the de-facto owner of the token.
Mint call inside the constructor: _mint(msg.sender, 150 * 1000 * 1000 * 1000000 * 10 ** decimals()) granting 150e6 tokens (1e6 scaling) with 18 decimals to the deployer.
Arithmetic state update _totalSupply += amount inside _mint (unchecked supply inflation path).
Arithmetic state update _balances[account] += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic state update _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer.
Arithmetic allowance decrement currentAllowance - amount passed to _approve in transferFrom.
Arithmetic allowance increment _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance.
Parameter name_ (string memory) of the ERC20 constructor, assigned to _name.
Parameter symbol_ (string memory) of the ERC20 constructor, assigned to _symbol.
Parameter account (address) of _mint, the token receiver.
Parameter amount (uint256) of _mint, the number of tokens created.
Parameter sender (address) of _transfer, the balance owner debited.
Parameter recipient (address) of _transfer, the balance credited.
Parameter amount (uint256) of _transfer, the value moved.
Local variable senderBalance = _balances[sender] in _transfer, used for the balance sufficiency require and the debit.
Parameter amount (uint256) of transferFrom, driving both _transfer and the allowance decrement.
Local variable currentAllowance = _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] in transferFrom.
Parameter spender (address) of increaseAllowance, the approved beneficiary.
Parameter addedValue (uint256) of increaseAllowance added to the current allowance.
Local variable currentAllowance = _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] in decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: The DirtySocks constructor executes the initial supply mint operation.
The constructor calls the internal _mint routine to create the initial supply.
msg.sender is the recipient argument of the constructor mint, so caller identity determines who receives the whole supply.
msg.sender flows into the constructor state change that assigns the entire token supply.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) determines the debited balance in the public transfer entry point.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller identity into the ERC20 logic.
transfer delegates to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer for the balance movement.
transferFrom calls _approve to write the reduced allowance.
The allowance arithmetic currentAllowance - amount is computed in transferFrom from storage state.
_mint performs the arithmetic update _totalSupply += amount.
_mint performs the arithmetic update _balances[account] += amount.
_transfer performs the arithmetic debit _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount.
increaseAllowance performs the allowance addition _allowances[...][spender] + addedValue.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance reads the allowance into currentAllowance before subtracting.
Constructor parameter name_ is stored into the _name state variable.
Constructor parameter symbol_ is stored into the _symbol state variable.
_mint amount parameter determines the credited balance amount.
_mint amount parameter determines the total supply increase.
_mint account parameter is the key of the credited _balances entry.
_transfer sender parameter is the key of the debited _balances entry.
_transfer recipient parameter is the key of the credited _balances entry.
_transfer amount parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
Local senderBalance is the value from which the transferred amount is subtracted.
transferFrom amount parameter is subtracted from currentAllowance.
Local currentAllowance is the minuend of the allowance decrement.
increaseAllowance spender parameter selects the allowance slot that is incremented.
increaseAllowance addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
_mint writes the _balances mapping.
_mint writes the _totalSupply state variable.
_transfer writes the _balances mapping for both parties.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_burn reduces the _balances entry of the burned account.
_burn reduces the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated, an external-call-like control transfer point.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated.
The constructor mint operation is realized by the _mint function invocation.
